capabilities: import local files from outside the vault via a command
export vault files to other locations on the device via a command
import files through a folder context menu
export files through a file context menu
extras: The README only lists the four features as headings with no explanations of how they work.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in commands to copy files between the vault and arbitrary locations on the device.
summary: File transfer plugin that adds commands and context menus to import files from outside the vault and export vault files to other device locations.
